evidence_gated.threshold_source: 95th per-update quantile over 1797 monitored updates from the 12 complete benign development runs
evidence_gated.residual_adaptation_rule: GPS residual is never a process-covariance feature; accept a bounded GPS-independent proposal only when protected edge evidence is healthy and both trusted-NIS and persistent-bias tests pass

bounded_covariance_adaptation.rejected_gate_behavior: freeze the most recently accepted covariance

learned_gps_independent.position_target: median future per-axis squared error between GPS displacement and encoder/IMU displacement aligned to the GPS local frame, after subtracting stationary GPS step noise
learned_gps_independent.heading_target: median future squared wrapped disagreement between IMU yaw increment and encoder-predicted yaw increment
learned_gps_independent.acceptance_rule: positive complete-run cross-validated MAE improvement over the training-fold median baseline for q_xx, q_yy, and q_tt
learned_gps_independent.activation_rule: a learned model is disabled unless the acceptance rule passes before attack evaluation
